The sculptor's signature on the statue
A gift from the government to the statue

questions.prompt: "Netaji ka Chashma" is written by:
questions.explanation: Swayam Prakash wrote this story about a statue of Subhash Chandra Bose and a humble chashmewala.

options: His long saffron robes and matted hair
His work as a temple priest
His simple, truthful conduct and devotion to Kabir's songs
questions.explanation: He was a grihastha with a farm, but his honesty and Kabir bhajans made people respect him as a saint.

questions.prompt: When Balgobin Bhagat's son died, what did he ask his daughter-in-law to do?

expected_answer.value: Go to her brother's home and remarry

options: Stay and cry for a year
Go to her brother's home and remarry

questions.prompt: Which collection of Surdas contains the "Bhramargeet" pads?
questions.explanation: Surdas's famous work Sursagar contains the Bhramargeet pads.

questions.prompt: The gopis say Uddhav is fortunate because he never felt attached to Krishna. They compare him to:

expected_answer.value: A lotus leaf that stays untouched by water

options: A bee that stays in one flower
A river that dries in summer
A lotus leaf that stays untouched by water

questions.prompt: The gopis say that Krishna is like "haril ki lakri" for them. This means:

expected_answer.value: They cling to him firmly and will never give him up

options: They find him dry and lifeless
They want to burn him away
They cling to him firmly and will never give him up
questions.explanation: The haril bird never lets go of the twig it holds; similarly the gopis hold on to their love for Krishna.

questions.prompt: Whose bow was broken in the swayamvar, making Parashuram furious?
questions.explanation: Parashuram was a devotee of Shiva, so the breaking of Shiva's bow provoked his anger.

questions.prompt: Who tries to calm Parashuram with polite and respectful words?

questions.prompt: The "Ram-Lakshman-Parashuram Samvad" is taken from which work of Tulsidas?
questions.explanation: This dialogue is a part of the Balkand of Tulsidas's Ramcharitmanas, composed in Awadhi.

questions.prompt: Which poet wrote "Chhaya mat chhoona"?
questions.explanation: Girija Kumar Mathur is the poet of 'Chhaya mat chhoona'.

questions.prompt: "Aatmakathya" belongs to which poetic movement of Hindi literature?
questions.explanation: Jaishankar Prasad was a leading Chhayavadi poet along with Nirala, Pant and Mahadevi Varma.

questions.prompt: Who is the poet of "Kanyadan" in Kshitij?
questions.explanation: 'Kanyadan' is a poem by Ritu Raj, about a mother's advice to her daughter.

questions.prompt: Shivpujan Sahay, author of "Mata ka Aanchal", also wrote the work:
questions.explanation: Dehati Duniya is a well-known novel by Shivpujan Sahay.

questions.prompt: In "Mata ka Aanchal", when a snake frightens the children, the child runs and takes shelter with:
questions.explanation: Frightened, the child runs home and hides in his mother's lap, though he normally stays close to his father; this shows a mother's comfort.

questions.prompt: "Mata ka Aanchal" is a part of which book?
questions.explanation: 'Mata ka Aanchal' is a lesson of the supplementary reader Kritika.

questions.prompt: What is the sthayi bhav of Karun ras?
questions.explanation: Karun ras has shok (grief) as its sthayi bhav.

questions.prompt: What is the sthayi bhav of Hasya ras?
questions.explanation: The sthayi bhav of Hasya ras is hasya itself.

questions.prompt: Which ras has "Nirved" as its sthayi bhav?
questions.explanation: Shant ras has nirved (detachment) as sthayi bhav.

questions.prompt: "Sher ko dekhkar sabhi bachche daud pade, unke chehre pasine se bhig gaye aur saans ukhad gayi." Which ras is shown?
questions.explanation: Fear (bhay) is the main feeling, so the ras is Bhayanak.

questions.prompt: What is the sthayi bhav of Raudra ras?
questions.explanation: Krodh is the sthayi bhav of Raudra ras.

questions.prompt: In "Vah sher ki tarah bahadur hai", which alankar is used?
questions.explanation: Two things are compared using the word 'ki tarah', so it is Upama.

questions.prompt: "Mano chandrama hi dharti par utar aaya ho." Which alankar is used?
questions.explanation: The word 'mano' expresses imagination (sambhavna) of one thing as another: Utpreksha.

questions.prompt: "Mukh-chandra par muskan khil gayi." Which alankar is it?
questions.explanation: The face is directly identified with the moon, without 'jaise' or 'mano': Rupak.

questions.prompt: In an Upama alankar, "upaman" is:

expected_answer.value: The thing with which comparison is made

options: The thing with which comparison is made
questions.explanation: In 'mukh chandra ke saman', mukh is upmey and chandra is upaman.

questions.prompt: What does the muhavara "naak kat jana" mean?
questions.explanation: 'Naak kat jana' means disgrace or loss of reputation.

questions.prompt: What does "ghee ke diye jalana" mean?
questions.explanation: The idiom means celebrating or rejoicing at something good.

questions.prompt: What does "doodh ka doodh, paani ka paani" mean?
questions.explanation: The idiom means complete justice where truth and falsehood are separated.

questions.prompt: "Ullu seedha karna" means:

expected_answer.value: To get one's work done by cleverness

options: To make an owl sit straight
To get one's work done by cleverness
questions.explanation: It means to get one's own selfish purpose fulfilled.

questions.prompt: "Anguthaa dikhana" means:
questions.explanation: The idiom stands for refusing bluntly.

questions.prompt: "Mata-pita" is which type of samas?
questions.explanation: Both parts are equally important and joined by 'aur': Dwandwa samas.

questions.prompt: "Pratidin" (har din) is which type of samas?
questions.explanation: The first word 'prati' is an avyay and gives the meaning: Avyayibhav.

questions.prompt: "Neelkamal" (neela jo kamal) is which type of samas?
questions.explanation: The first word is a visheshan of the second, with vigrah 'neela jo kamal': Karmdharay.

questions.prompt: "Dashanan" (dus hain aanan jiske, arthat Ravan) is which type of samas?
questions.explanation: Neither word gives the meaning; a third thing (Ravan) is indicated: Bahuvrihi.

questions.prompt: "Trilok" (teen lokon ka samuh) is which type of samas?
questions.explanation: The first word is a number and the compound denotes a group: Dwigu.

questions.prompt: "Himalay" is formed from hima + alay. Which sandhi is it?
questions.explanation: 'a' + 'a' merge into 'aa': Dirgh svar sandhi.

questions.prompt: "Sanmarg" is formed from sat + marg. Which type of sandhi is this?
questions.explanation: The last consonant of 'sat' changes before 'm': Vyanjan sandhi.

questions.prompt: "Manohar" is formed from manah + har. Which type of sandhi is this?
questions.explanation: The visarg of 'manah' changes into 'o': Visarg sandhi.

questions.prompt: "Sadaiv" (sada + ev) is an example of:
questions.explanation: 'a' + 'e' becomes 'ai', which is Vriddhi sandhi.

questions.prompt: "Atyadhik" (ati + adhik) is an example of:
questions.explanation: 'i' changes into 'y' before a dissimilar vowel: Yan sandhi.

questions.prompt: "Seeta gaati hai." is which type of vakya by structure?
questions.explanation: The sentence has just one subject and one predicate (one main clause).

questions.prompt: "Jo mehnat karta hai, vah safal hota hai." is which type of vakya?
questions.explanation: It has a main clause and a dependent clause (jo...): Mishra vakya.

questions.prompt: "Main bazaar gaya lekin dukan band thi." is which type of vakya?
questions.explanation: Two independent clauses are joined by 'lekin': Sanyukt vakya.

questions.prompt: "Jab baarish hui, tab fasal lahlahane lagi." is:
questions.explanation: 'Jab' introduces a dependent clause attached to a main clause.

questions.prompt: "Kitab padhi jati hai." is in which vachya?
questions.explanation: The verb agrees with the karm (kitab), so it is Karm vachya.

questions.prompt: "Bachche khel rahe hain." is in which vachya?
questions.explanation: The verb follows the kartta (bachche): Kartri vachya.

questions.prompt: "Mujhse hansa nahi jata." is in which vachya?
questions.explanation: Only the action (bhav) is stressed and the verb is intransitive/neutral: Bhav vachya.

questions.prompt: In Karm vachya, with whom does the verb agree?
questions.explanation: In karm vachya the verb's linga and vachan follow the karm.

questions.prompt: A letter to the editor about garbage in your locality is which type of letter?
questions.explanation: Letters to editors, officials and organisations are formal letters.

questions.prompt: In an aupcharik patra, the "Vishay" line is usually written:

expected_answer.value: After 'Sewa mein' and the receiver's address and before the salutation

options: After 'Sewa mein' and the receiver's address and before the salutation
questions.explanation: Format: sender's address, date, receiver, vishay, salutation (Mahoday), body, closing.

questions.prompt: Which closing is appropriate for a student writing to the Principal?
questions.explanation: A student writes 'Aapka/Aapki aagyakari shishya/shishya' to the Principal.

questions.prompt: Which salutation suits a formal letter to the Principal?
questions.explanation: Formal letters begin with 'Mahoday' or 'Mahodaya'.

questions.prompt: An anuchchhed should deal with:

expected_answer.value: One central idea, with connected sentences

options: One central idea, with connected sentences
questions.explanation: A good anuchchhed develops a single theme in a unified flow.

questions.prompt: Which is the best structure of an anuchchhed?

expected_answer.value: Beginning, development of the idea, and a conclusion

options: Beginning, development of the idea, and a conclusion
questions.explanation: It should open with the topic, develop it with points, and end with a brief conclusion.

questions.prompt: Which is NOT a sign of a good anuchchhed?

expected_answer.value: Repeating the same sentence again and again to fill space

options: Repeating the same sentence again and again to fill space
questions.explanation: Repetition without new ideas weakens the unity of the paragraph.

questions.prompt: In a suchna, the heading "Suchna" is written:

expected_answer.value: At the top, along with the name of the school or office

options: Inside the middle of the text
At the top, along with the name of the school or office
questions.explanation: A notice begins with the issuing institution's name and the word Suchna.

questions.prompt: Which of the following must appear in a suchna for a school event?

expected_answer.value: Date of issue, name of issuer with post

options: Date of issue, name of issuer with post
questions.explanation: A notice carries date, event details and the name and designation of the issuer.

questions.prompt: A suchna should be:
options: Written in the first person narrative
questions.explanation: A notice is brief and direct so that readers can understand it quickly.

questions.prompt: गद्यांश: "पेड़ हमें छाया, फल और स्वच्छ वायु देते हैं। यदि हम वृक्षों को काटते रहेंगे तो धरती पर जीवन कठिन हो जाएगा। इसलिए अधिक से अधिक पेड़ लगाना हमारा कर्तव्य है।" इसका सबसे उपयुक्त शीर्षक कौन-सा है?

questions.prompt: गद्यांश: "समय बीत जाने पर पछताने से कुछ नहीं मिलता। जो विद्यार्थी हर काम समय पर करता है, वही आगे बढ़ता है।" इसका मुख्य संदेश क्या है?

questions.prompt: अपठित गद्यांश का शीर्षक चुनते समय किस बात से बचना चाहिए?

expected_answer.value: ऐसा शीर्षक चुनना जो केवल एक छोटे-से अंश पर आधारित हो

ऐसा शीर्षक चुनना जो केवल एक छोटे-से अंश पर आधारित हो
questions.explanation: शीर्षक पूरे गद्यांश के मूल भाव को दर्शाए; केवल एक अंश पर आधारित शीर्षक अधूरा रहता है।

questions.prompt: काव्यांश: "चलना हमारा काम है, गति ही हमारा गान है; रुकना कभी जाना नहीं, यह कर्म का अपमान है।" इस काव्यांश का भाव क्या है?

expected_answer.value: निरंतर कर्म करते रहने की प्रेरणा

questions.prompt: "जो परिश्रम करता है, वह सफल होता है।" रचना के आधार पर यह कौन-सा वाक्य है?

questions.prompt: "वह आया पर बैठा नहीं।" रचना के आधार पर यह कौन-सा वाक्य है?
questions.explanation: दो स्वतंत्र उपवाक्य 'पर' से जुड़े हैं, अतः संयुक्त वाक्य है।

questions.prompt: "बच्चा हँस रहा है।" रचना के आधार पर यह कौन-सा वाक्य है?
questions.explanation: इसमें एक ही उद्देश्य और एक ही विधेय है, इसलिए यह सरल वाक्य है।

questions.prompt: "जब वर्षा हुई तब किसान प्रसन्न हो गए।" रचना के आधार पर यह कौन-सा वाक्य है?
questions.explanation: 'जब' से आरंभ होने वाला उपवाक्य आश्रित है और 'तब' वाला मुख्य उपवाक्य है।

questions.prompt: "पत्र पढ़ा जाता है।" इस वाक्य में कौन-सा वाच्य है?

questions.prompt: "सीता गीत गाती है।" इस वाक्य में कौन-सा वाच्य है?
questions.explanation: क्रिया कर्ता (सीता) के लिंग-वचन के अनुसार है, अतः कर्तृवाच्य है।

questions.prompt: "उससे बैठा नहीं जाता।" इस वाक्य में कौन-सा वाच्य है?

questions.prompt: कर्तृवाच्य "माली पौधे सींचता है।" का कर्मवाच्य रूप कौन-सा है?

माली से पौधा सींचा नहीं जाता।
questions.explanation: कर्मवाच्य में कर्म प्रधान होता है और क्रिया 'सींचे जाते हैं' कर्म के अनुसार बदलती है।

questions.prompt: "सुंदर फूल खिला है।" में "सुंदर" का पद परिचय क्या है?

expected_answer.value: गुणवाचक विशेषण, 'फूल' की विशेषता बताने वाला

options: गुणवाचक विशेषण, 'फूल' की विशेषता बताने वाला
questions.explanation: 'सुंदर' फूल (विशेष्य) का गुण बताता है, इसलिए गुणवाचक विशेषण है।

questions.prompt: "बालक धीरे-धीरे चलता है।" में "धीरे-धीरे" का पद परिचय क्या है?
questions.explanation: यह क्रिया के होने की रीति बताता है, इसलिए रीतिवाचक क्रियाविशेषण है।

questions.prompt: "हम विद्यालय जाते हैं।" में "हम" का पद परिचय क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'हम' बोलने वाले के लिए प्रयुक्त होता है, इसलिए उत्तम पुरुष का पुरुषवाचक सर्वनाम है।

questions.prompt: "राम और श्याम खेल रहे हैं।" में "और" का पद परिचय क्या है?
questions.explanation: 'और' दो शब्दों को जोड़ता है, अतः समुच्चयबोधक अव्यय है।

questions.prompt: "उसकी आँखें कमल जैसी सुंदर हैं।" में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation: 'जैसी' वाचक शब्द से आँखों की कमल से समानता बताई गई है: उपमा अलंकार।

questions.prompt: "मानो चाँद आकाश में दीपक बनकर जल रहा हो।" में कौन-सा अलंकार है?

questions.prompt: "सागर की लहरें गले मिलने दौड़ीं।" में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation: लहरों पर मनुष्य जैसा व्यवहार (दौड़ना, गले मिलना) आरोपित किया गया है: मानवीकरण।

questions.prompt: "उसने ऐसी दौड़ लगाई कि हवा भी पीछे छूट गई।" में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
